title: CLPDS Planetary Exploration Data Visualization Suite: Interactive In-Situ Science and Stratigraphy of China's Lunar and Mars Missions
description: FAIR-compliant scientific analysis pipeline, publication-quality LaTeX manuscript, and interactive WebGL/Three.js multi-mission visualization suite for scientific data released by China's Lunar and Planetary Data Release System (CLPDS / NAOC / CNSA). Spanning Chang'e-1 through Chang'e-6 lunar missions and the Tianwen-1 / Zhurong Mars mission, this repository provides interactive 3D planetary globes, ground-penetrating radar (GPR) subsurface stratigraphy profiling (LPR and RoRAD), Vis-NIR and LIBS spectroscopy laboratories (VNIS, LMS, MarSCoDe), and Martian boundary layer meteorological and geophysics dashboards (MCS, RoMAG, LND).
notes: Software and data pipeline repository accompanying the publication submitted to Nature Publishing Group. Maintained under the DeepSpaceAg / CoSE research initiative at Purdue University.
